page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 1919 GB of local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the instance delivers modest compute performance. Both single-core and multi-core CPU tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the processor in the bottom 25% tier. However, memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks performs at an average level, as does the Passmark CPU score. Redis SET operations also achieve average performance, reaching 6.02 million operations per second. Conversely, single-threaded compression and medium-model LLM inference speeds are weak to poor, reflecting the older processor architecture.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and the substantial 1919 GB local SSD storage, this instance offers a specific resource density profile. While its raw compute performance is lower compared to newer hardware generations, the high local storage capacity and 64.0 GB memory footprint make it qualitatively cost-efficient for storage-heavy workloads that do not require intensive CPU processing. It is best suited for database hosting, caching layers like Redis, and general-purpose storage-bound applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 server instance configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs, 64.0 GB of RAM, and a substantial 1919 GB of local SSD storage. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, this KVM-virtualized instance delivers a balanced 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Performance benchmarks indicate modest compute capabilities, with stress-ng and Geekbench scores falling into the bottom 25% tier. However, the instance maintains average performance in large-block memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations, achieving 6.02 million operations per second. Lacking a GPU and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, the ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is not designed for high-performance computing or intensive AI workloads. Instead, its large local SSD storage and dedicated resources make it a qualitatively cost-effective option for storage-centric applications, database hosting, and caching layers that prioritize local disk capacity over raw processing speed.
